title: Tree Traversal with Recursive CTE
description: Given a 'nodes' table where each node has a parent_id (NULL for root), classify each node as 'Root' (no parent), 'Inner' (has both parent and children), or 'Leaf' (has parent but no children).
hints: Use a recursive CTE to find all ancestors/descendants
Or use simpler approach with subqueries: check p_id IS NULL for Root
Check EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes WHERE parent_id = n.id) for Inner vs Leaf
